_meta.role: Machine Learning Engineer II (Applied Research & Model Development)

summary: M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from Rochester Institute of Technology (RIT), NY. Developed and evaluated deep learning models for medical imaging, including a custom data pipeline and U-Net segmentation stack for the BraTS 2020 multi-modal MRI dataset and a high-resolution microscopy inspection pipeline. Fine-tuned vision transformers in PyTorch on medical-domain data, and comfortable owning experimental design, model evaluation, and ML pipeline development alongside cross-functional research teams.

experience.title: Research Fellowship
bullets: Engineered a custom data pipeline for the BraTS 2020 multi-modal MRI dataset with medical imaging augmentation and batch-loading memory management for 3D volumetric inputs.
Trained U-Net segmentation models with VGG-16, VGG-19, and ResNet-50 backbones; evaluated on Dice Score and IoU and reported accuracy-latency trade-offs for deployment.
Led a cross-functional team of 7 as the sole ML-experienced member, delivering the full pipeline within a 6-week window.

experience.title: AI/ML Intern
bullets: Fine-tuned DONUT, an OCR-free document understanding transformer, on a custom medical dataset for structured field extraction.
Built preprocessing and training pipelines in PyTorch using the HuggingFace VisionEncoderDecoder API with domain-specific tokens.
Improved validation accuracy from 55% to 93% through preprocessing redesign and model tuning.

experience.title: Research Intern (Capstone)
bullets: Architected a surface inspection pipeline for microscopic crack analysis combining custom image stitching, wavelet denoising, and monocular depth estimation.
Designed an alpha-blended sym6+bior3.5 wavelet bank to suppress low-frequency noise, reaching PSNR 86 against a PSNR 65 baseline.

experience.title: Deep Learning Intern
bullets: Curated and annotated a custom detection dataset and trained YOLOv8n on 1,133 images to 83% mAP@50 on held-out validation; exported to ONNX and TFLite for deployment.

projects.name: Model Compression and Benchmarking for Constrained Deployment
bullets: Reduced GPU memory footprint by ~55% via 8-bit quantization (bitsandbytes LLM.int8()) on TinyLlama 1.1B; profiled peak VRAM and inference latency using pynvml and psutil.
Benchmarked across HellaSwag, GSM8K, and ARC: under 1% accuracy degradation with a +0.09 perplexity increase.

awards: 1st Prize, Poster Presentation - 2D and 3D Image Mosaicing of Microscopic Images (2024)
